outside_body: This app works inside Telegram only. Open the bot and press “Open Googlagent”.
expired_body: Close this window and open the app from the bot again.
denied_body: Close this window and open the app from the bot again. If that does not help, contact the studio owner.
error_body: Could not reach the server. Please try again in a minute.
catalog_error: The catalog did not load. Please try again.
empty_branch: Skills of this branch will come later.
road_agent: The agent does it: the platform leads the work, you accept the result.
road_self: Do it yourself: the agent gives a prompt pack, you work on your side.
price_note: Prices come from the model catalog when the skill runs.
unlock_level: The agent road opens at level {level}. Doing it yourself is open from level 1.
unlock_proof: What to bring so the skill counts:
profile_intro: Tell me by voice who you are, what you want and how much time you have. I fill in the form and ask only what is missing.
profile_form: Fill in the form with buttons
profile_voice_off: Voice recognition is not connected yet. Fill in the form with buttons.
profile_continue: We continue from the same question.
rec_hint: Speak freely: who you are, what you want in 10 weeks and in a year, how much time and budget you have, what you can do.
rec_sending: Listening and noting the main points…
rec_limit: Recording stopped: the five-minute limit is reached.
mic_unavailable_title: Recording in the Mini App is unavailable
mic_unavailable_body: Send a voice message to the bot in the chat: I note the same, and the result appears here. You can also fill in the form with buttons.
mic_denied_body: Microphone access is not allowed. Allow it in Telegram settings or send a voice message to the bot in the chat.
mic_none_body: No microphone found. Send a voice message to the bot in the chat or fill in the form with buttons.
voice_err_asr_error: I could not recognise the recording. Try again or fill in the form with buttons.
voice_err_empty: I hear no speech in the recording. Record again, closer to the microphone.
voice_err_nothing: I found nothing about you in the story. Tell me about your role, goals, time and experience.
voice_err_no_asr: Voice recognition is not connected right now. Fill in the form with buttons.
voice_err_rate_limited: Too many recordings in a row. Try again in a few minutes.
voice_err_too_big: The recording is too long. Keep it shorter.
voice_err_unsupported: This recording format does not fit. Send a voice message to the bot in the chat.
voice_err_network: The recording was not sent. Check the connection and try again.
q_error: The answer was not saved. Please try again.
q_stale: The screen was out of date, showing the current question.
done_body: Here is what I noted about you. Next I build your profile card.
card_intro: Check that everything is right. After “Right” I create your agent passport.
card_private_note: Time, budget and country stay with you only and never go to the group.
passport_old: Agent passport v{version} exists, but the card has changed. Confirm the new version.
passport_published: The public part, without money, contacts and age, is posted in your topic in the group.
passport_not_published: Nothing is posted to the group: you are not there yet or the post failed.
card_error: It was not saved. Please try again.
